name: loan-note
title: Sample loan note
for_each: select id,code from loans where state in ('reserved','out')

sections.title: Loan details
sections.sql: select l.code,c.name recipient,c.organisation,l.purpose,l.starts_on,l.due_on,l.destination,l.terms_ref,l.shipping_ref,l.state from loans l join contacts c on c.id=l.contact_id where l.id=$1
sections.note: Custody record for human review. This is not an invoice or a signed contract.

sections.title: Pieces
sections.sql: select barcode,name,brand,season,returned_on from v_custody where loan_id=$1 order by barcode

name: return-reconciliation
title: Sample return reconciliation
for_each: select id,code from loans where dispatched_on is not null

sections.title: Recorded return condition
sections.sql: select barcode,name,due_on,returned_on,return_condition,return_location,lost_on,loss_reason,case when lost_on is not null then 'Recorded loss' when returned_on is null then 'Outstanding' else 'Received' end result from v_custody where loan_id=$1 order by barcode

sections.title: Physical observations
sections.sql: select observed_on,location,condition,note,actor from stocktakes where sample_id=$1 order by observed_on desc
